scenarios.title: A｜卫生问题
scenarios.setting: 在“向酒店提出投诉”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“卫生问题”。

turns.text: Front desk. How can I help you?

turns.prompt: 关于「向酒店提出投诉」，你想让对方了解你的需求或来意，会怎么说明？

choices.text: Hi, I’d like to make a complaint about the cleanliness of my room.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I’d like to make a complaint about the cleanliness of my room.
feedback.explanation: “complaint”指投诉，是正式提出问题或不满的用词。

choices.text: I’m afraid I’m not satisfied with the condition of my room.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m afraid I’m not satisfied with the condition of my room.
feedback.explanation: “I’m afraid”引出可能让对方失望或为难的信息，是缓和语气的说法，不一定表示害怕。

choices.text: I’d like to report a cleanliness issue with my room.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to report a cleanliness issue with my room.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

choices.text: My room really wasn’t cleaned properly.

feedback.naturalExpression: My room really wasn’t cleaned properly.
feedback.explanation: “wasn’t cleaned”用被动形式说明清洁没有完成，把问题落在服务结果上。

choices.text: I want to complain your cleaning.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I’d like to make a complaint about the cleanliness of my room.
feedback.explanation: “complain about …”需要“about”；具体说“cleanliness”能表明投诉的是清洁状况。

turns.text: I’m sorry to hear that. What seems to be the problem?

turns.prompt: 关于「向酒店提出投诉」，你想说明遇到的问题或处理后的情况，会怎么说？

choices.text: The bathroom was dirty when I checked in.

feedback.naturalExpression: The bathroom was dirty when I checked in.
feedback.explanation: 提供自己经历或做过的具体情况，让对方能在已知信息上继续确认。

choices.text: There were stains on the sheets and used towels in the bathroom.

feedback.naturalExpression: There were stains on the sheets and used towels in the bathroom.
feedback.explanation: 用“there be”说明存在的事物或情况，先呈现事实，便于对方继续处理。

choices.text: The room doesn’t appear to have been cleaned properly before I arrived.

feedback.naturalExpression: The room doesn’t appear to have been cleaned properly before I arrived.
feedback.explanation: “I arrived”说明已经到达的时间或方式，便于核对行程记录。

choices.text: I already asked housekeeping to clean it, but the problem wasn’t fully resolved.

feedback.naturalExpression: I already asked housekeeping to clean it, but the problem wasn’t fully resolved.
feedback.explanation: “already”强调事情已经发生或完成，适合核对进度与时间先后。

choices.text: The cleaning was very terrible.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: The bathroom was dirty when I checked in.
feedback.explanation: “terrible”已经语气很强，“very”显得多余；说明哪里没清理干净，比笼统评价更便于处理。

turns.text: I sincerely apologize. We can send housekeeping up immediately.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: I’d appreciate that, but I’ve already been waiting quite a while.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d appreciate that, but I’ve already been waiting quite a while.
feedback.explanation: “I’ve already”强调这一步已经做过，能在沟通中确认进度。

choices.text: Could you make sure the room is cleaned thoroughly this time?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you make sure the room is cleaned thoroughly this time?
feedback.explanation: “make sure”表示核实、确认，能说明重复提问是为避免理解出错。

choices.text: At this point, I’d prefer to move to another room.

feedback.naturalExpression: At this point, I’d prefer to move to another room.
feedback.explanation: 把选择说成自己的偏好，可以表明立场，而不必否定另一种选择。

choices.text: I don’t think simply sending housekeeping again is enough.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t think simply sending housekeeping again is enough.
feedback.explanation: “I don’t think”把不同意见表达为自己的判断，而不是直接断定对方错误。

turns.text: I understand. Let me see whether another room is available.

turns.prompt: 你想说明日期、时长或时间上的需求，会怎么说？

choices.text: Thank you. I’d like this resolved as soon as possible.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thank you. I’d like this resolved as soon as possible.
feedback.explanation: “as soon as possible”表示尽快，说明事情紧急，但没有指定一个确定时点。

choices.text: I’d appreciate it if you could arrange another room.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d appreciate it if you could arrange another room.
feedback.explanation: “I’d appreciate”将希望对方做的事与感谢联系起来，语气比直接命令更委婉。

choices.text: Thank you for looking into it.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thank you for looking into it.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

scenarios.title: B｜噪音问题
scenarios.setting: 在“向酒店提出投诉”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“噪音问题”。

turns.prompt: 关于「向酒店提出投诉」，你想说明遇到的问题或处理后的情况，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hi, I’d like to complain about the noise from the room next door.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I’d like to complain about the noise from the room next door.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

choices.text: I’ve already reported the noise, but it hasn’t stopped.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ve already reported the noise, but it hasn’t stopped.
feedback.explanation: “I’ve already”强调这一步已经做过，能在沟通中确认进度。

choices.text: I’m still being disturbed by loud noise from another room.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m still being disturbed by loud noise from another room.
feedback.explanation: “still”强调原来的状态目前没有改变，是跟进进度或确认安排时的关键信息。

choices.text: I’ve been unable to sleep because of the noise.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ve been unable to sleep because of the noise.
feedback.explanation: “I’ve been”把过去的经历或持续情况与现在联系起来，适合交代背景。

choices.text: I complained before but they are still noisy.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I’d like to complain about the noise from the room next door.
feedback.explanation: 这句能说明以前投诉过；点明噪音来源和问题仍存在，有助于前台判断为什么需要再次处理。

turns.text: I’m sorry. We did speak to the guests earlier.

turns.prompt: 关于「向酒店提出投诉」，你想说明遇到的问题或处理后的情况，会怎么说？

choices.text: Unfortunately, it hasn’t made any difference.

feedback.naturalExpression: Unfortunately, it hasn’t made any difference.
feedback.explanation: “hasn’t”与过去分词搭配说明截至现在仍未完成的事，方便对方判断当前进度。

choices.text: The noise stopped for a while, but it’s started again.

feedback.naturalExpression: The noise stopped for a while, but it’s started again.
feedback.explanation: 转折后的内容说明当前需要注意的不同情况，能把顾虑或限制说清楚。

choices.text: It’s been going on for several hours now.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s been going on for several hours now.
feedback.explanation: 接着上文说明对象的具体情况，指代清楚时无需重复完整名称。

choices.text: I really need you to do something about it.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Unfortunately, it hasn’t made any difference.
feedback.explanation: 这句明确要求处理，语气坚定，在问题久未解决时可以使用；补上希望采取的措施会更具体。

turns.text: I understand. We can contact them again.

turns.prompt: 你想要求酒店进一步处理持续的噪音，会怎么说？

choices.text: Could you please take further action this time?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you please take further action this time?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: If the noise continues, I’d like to change rooms.

feedback.naturalExpression: If the noise continues, I’d like to change rooms.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

choices.text: Is there a quieter room available?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there a quieter room available?
feedback.explanation: “available”指可获得或可使用的；询问服务时常指有没有余位。

choices.text: I’ve already given this some time, so I’d prefer another solution.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ve already given this some time, so I’d prefer another solution.
feedback.explanation: “I’ve already”强调这一步已经做过，能在沟通中确认进度。

turns.text: Let me check what we can arrange.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Thank you. I’d appreciate a quieter room if possible.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thank you. I’d appreciate a quieter room if possible.
feedback.explanation: “I’d appreciate”将希望对方做的事与感谢联系起来，语气比直接命令更委婉。

choices.text: Thanks. I’d really like to get some sleep tonight.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. I’d really like to get some sleep tonight.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

scenarios.title: C｜设施故障
scenarios.setting: 在“向酒店提出投诉”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“设施故障”。

turns.prompt: 关于「向酒店提出投诉」，你想让对方了解你的需求或来意，会怎么说明？

choices.text: Hi, I’d like to complain about an issue in my room that still hasn’t been fixed.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I’d like to complain about an issue in my room that still hasn’t been fixed.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

choices.text: I reported the air conditioner earlier, but it’s still not working.

feedback.naturalExpression: I reported the air conditioner earlier, but it’s still not working.
feedback.explanation: “air conditioner”指空调设备，通常作为可数名词。

choices.text: Maintenance came to look at the problem, but it hasn’t been resolved.

feedback.naturalExpression: Maintenance came to look at the problem, but it hasn’t been resolved.
feedback.explanation: “hasn’t been resolved”表示问题到现在还没解决，适合跟进之前已反映的情况。

choices.text: I’ve already contacted the front desk twice about this issue.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ve already contacted the front desk twice about this issue.
feedback.explanation: “I’ve already”强调这一步已经做过，能在沟通中确认进度。

choices.text: Nobody fixed my air conditioner until now.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I’d like to complain about an issue in my room that still hasn’t been fixed.
feedback.explanation: “until now”可能让人以为刚刚已修好；若仍未解决，使用“still hasn’t been fixed”更明确。

turns.text: I’m very sorry. Let me check the maintenance report.

turns.prompt: 关于「向酒店提出投诉」，你想说明遇到的问题或处理后的情况，会怎么说？

choices.text: I’ve been without air conditioning for several hours now.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ve been without air conditioning for several hours now.
feedback.explanation: “I’ve been”把过去的经历或持续情况与现在联系起来，适合交代背景。

choices.text: The problem is making the room very uncomfortable.

feedback.naturalExpression: The problem is making the room very uncomfortable.
feedback.explanation: “uncomfortable”指不舒服或不自在，描述的是自己的感受。

choices.text: I understand repairs can take time, but I need another solution.

feedback.naturalExpression: I understand repairs can take time, but I need another solution.
feedback.explanation: “I understand”承认听懂了对方的理由或难处，为继续协商提供基础。

choices.text: I don’t think it’s reasonable to keep waiting.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t think it’s reasonable to keep waiting.
feedback.explanation: “I don’t think”把不同意见表达为自己的判断，而不是直接断定对方错误。

turns.text: I understand. We can send maintenance back up.

turns.prompt: 你想说出自己的偏好或顾虑，会怎么表达？

choices.text: I’d rather change rooms at this point.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d rather change rooms at this point.
feedback.explanation: 把选择说成自己的偏好，可以表明立场，而不必否定另一种选择。

choices.text: Could you arrange another room instead?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you arrange another room instead?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: If it can’t be fixed immediately, I’d like to be moved.

feedback.naturalExpression: If it can’t be fixed immediately, I’d like to be moved.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

choices.text: I’d prefer not to wait for another repair attempt.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d prefer not to wait for another repair attempt.
feedback.explanation: 把选择说成自己的偏好，可以表明立场，而不必否定另一种选择。

scenarios.title: D｜服务问题
scenarios.setting: 在“向酒店提出投诉”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“服务问题”。

turns.prompt: 关于「向酒店提出投诉」，你想让对方了解你的需求或来意，会怎么说明？

choices.text: Hi, I’d like to raise a concern about the service I’ve received.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I’d like to raise a concern about the service I’ve received.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

choices.text: I’d like to make a complaint about how my request was handled.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to make a complaint about how my request was handled.
feedback.explanation: “complaint”指投诉，是正式提出问题或不满的用词。

choices.text: I’m not happy with the way this situation has been dealt with.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not happy with the way this situation has been dealt with.
feedback.explanation: “has been”把过去开始的状态与现在联系起来，常用于说明持续情况或经历。

choices.text: I’ve had to contact the front desk several times about the same issue.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ve had to contact the front desk several times about the same issue.
feedback.explanation: “front desk”指前台，是酒店办理入住、咨询等事项的接待处。

choices.text: Your service is very bad.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I’d like to raise a concern about the service I’ve received.
feedback.explanation: “very bad”只有总体评价；指出等待、清洁等具体问题，对方才知道需要改善什么。

turns.text: I’m sorry to hear that. Could you tell me what happened?

turns.prompt: 对方想了解出了什么问题，你会怎样说明情况？

choices.text: I called several times for towels, but no one followed up.

feedback.naturalExpression: I called several times for towels, but no one followed up.
feedback.explanation: 转折后的内容说明当前需要注意的不同情况，能把顾虑或限制说清楚。

choices.text: I was told someone would come within ten minutes, but I waited nearly an hour.

feedback.naturalExpression: I was told someone would come within ten minutes, but I waited nearly an hour.
feedback.explanation: “was told”表示这是此前被告知的信息；交代来源，有助于核对不同说法。

choices.text: I understand the hotel is busy, but I wasn’t given any updates.

feedback.naturalExpression: I understand the hotel is busy, but I wasn’t given any updates.
feedback.explanation: “I understand”承认听懂了对方的理由或难处，为继续协商提供基础。

choices.text: What bothered me most was that nobody explained what was happening.

feedback.naturalExpression: What bothered me most was that nobody explained what was happening.
feedback.explanation: “bothered me most”指出最困扰或最受伤的地方，让沟通聚焦主要影响。

turns.text: I apologize. That’s not the level of service we aim to provide.

turns.prompt: 你想请酒店明确后续由谁处理问题，会怎么说？

choices.text: I’d just like someone to take responsibility for resolving the issue.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d just like someone to take responsibility for resolving the issue.
feedback.explanation: “take responsibility”表示承担责任；谈工作问题时，可以据此明确谁负责哪一部分。

choices.text: Could you make sure the request is handled now?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you make sure the request is handled now?
feedback.explanation: “make sure”表示核实、确认，能说明重复提问是为避免理解出错。

choices.text: I’d appreciate an explanation of what happened.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d appreciate an explanation of what happened.
feedback.explanation: “I’d appreciate”将希望对方做的事与感谢联系起来，语气比直接命令更委婉。

choices.text: I’d like to know what you can do to make this right.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to know what you can do to make this right.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

turns.text: Of course. Let me see what I can do for you.
